About Me

Who I Am

BS Software Engineering graduate from the University of Central Punjab (UCP), Lahore. My interests span DevOps, cloud computing, Linux, cybersecurity, AI automation, and full-stack web development — with hands-on experience in Docker, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, and deploying applications on the cloud.

I have a genuine passion for mathematics — linear algebra, stochastic processes, discrete structures, and calculus — and enjoy how mathematical thinking sharpens problem solving in software and AI.

Eager to contribute to real-world projects, automate workflows, and keep learning across DevOps, security, AI, and beyond.
